#summary MeCab. Japanese morphology-analyzing library.

  [http://mecab.sourceforge.net/ Official site for MeCab] (Nihongo only).

  MeCab is a text-parsing engine that splits Japanese text into it's separate morphemes. For example the sentence 「このような例は極端かもしれない」 will be split into these morphemes:

||Morpheme:||この||よう||な||例||は||極端||かも||しれ||ない||
||Reading: ||  ||  ||  ||れい||  ||きょくたん||  ||  ||  ||
||         ||pre-noun adj.||noun||aux. verb||noun||particle||noun||particle||verb||aux. verb||

  The author of MeCab is Yuuichi Teranishi.

== Installing ==

  MeCab must be installed by itself.

  [MecabInstallationWindows Installation on Windows]

  [MecabInstallationMacOSX Installation on Mac OS X]

  [MecabInstallationLinux Installation on Linux]
